values.note: 2026 rates: electric/water sites $36-42 a night (the rate table carries $36, $38 and $42 site variants), a double site $76; the 12 primitive impact-pad sites (no hookups, vehicles 15-23 ft) $26.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232555/rates (2026 'Peak Season' 05-01 to 09-29: RV ELECTRIC $36/$38, STANDARD ELECTRIC $36/$38/$42 and $76, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All 106 public sites bookable on recreation.gov, up to the arrival day (cutoff 0). 14 days within any 30; changing names, sites or chaining reservations to stay longer is prohibited. Gate locked 10 pm - 7 am; check in by 10 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232555 (rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0; notices 'Maximum stay is 14-days within 30 day period', 'Entrance gate OPENS at 7 a.m. and LOCKS at 10 p.m.') + RIDB catalog (106 sites, all reservable), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232555 ('94 with full water and electric hookups') + RIDB catalog (94 sites Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 106 public sites: 94 with water and electric (32 pull-through) and 12 primitive impact-pad sites for vehicles of 15-23 ft; 2 more are park-attendant sites.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232555 ('106 public use campsites (94 with full water and electric hookups and 12 primitive sites with impact pad only)') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length up to 60, 32 pull-through), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 4 comfort stations with showers, 2 dump stations, boat ramp and courtesy dock, 2 swim beaches, 4 playgrounds; gatehouse.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232555 ('4 comfort stations with showers, 2 dump stations, 1 boat ramp, 1 courtesy dock, 4 playgrounds, 2 designated swim areas/beaches'; amenities Flush Toilets, Showers, Dump Station), read 2026-10-21

summary: USACE-operated (Savannah District, Hartwell project office 888-893-0678): fees updated 36/38 -> $36-42 (electric sites; primitive $26 noted, not the base since those pads cap at 23 ft and are primitive); booking confirmed recreation.gov, 14 in 30 days; 50 A + water (now manual); 106 sites to 60 ft with pull-throughs; showers, flush toilets, 2 dump stations. Season NOT recorded: no Corps page states Coneross's dates (the district camping page is bare, the rec.gov rate season May 1 - Sept 29 is not a campground season, the calendar is uninformative past September). Sewer left unknown (only 2 catalog sites say sewer). Note left as is.
